title: 0018.21 tenant onboard UI (onboarded-only list)
description:
## Why
Kill catalog picker. Onboard from canonical.

## Acceptance Criteria
- List is onboarded only. Onboard searches canonical-not-on-tenant
- Surfaces on detail; one-surface no checkbox group; last-off confirm deletes that surface slot
- No Add-connector catalog. Kill adminConnectorCatalogSeed as entitle source
- Prove: OpsConnectorsPage tests; picker absent
notes:
Playbook: feature.md
architect skipped: decision-locked.md already specifies onboarded-only list, onboard search of canonical-not-on-tenant, surfaces on detail, one-surface no checkbox group, last-off confirm deletes that surface slot, no Add-connector catalog. Two shapes compared: (1) entitlement row is onboard with surfaces[] and search GET registry/connectors minus onboarded (picked) vs (2) a new onboard resource. Rejected extra surface when tenant_connector_entitlements already is (tenant, connector).

Throughput checkpoint:
- Blocking first: surfaces_json on entitlements + PUT {surfaces} + availableOnboardSurfaces from snapshot/first-class.
- Independent workstreams: n/a (list, detail, PUT, class-c drop share SurfaceKind).
- Shared mutable state: tenant_connector_entitlements + class-c slots; single writer (CP PUT).
- Smallest safe decomposition: one worker so list/detail/PUT agree on onboard = non-empty surfaces[].

Principles: model-the-domain (onboard = entitlement with non-empty surfaces[]), foundational-thinking (types first), laziness (reuse entitlements, no new table), redesign-from-first-principles (kill catalog picker rather than filter it), boundary-discipline (parse surfaces at HTTP), type-system-discipline (graphql never a surface id), separate-before-serializing (one writer), prove-it-works (OpsConnectorsPage tests; picker absent; CP last-off deletes class-c slot).
